$schema-note: Dated, justified, SCOPED allowlist for the OSV dependency gate (scripts/osv-gate.mjs, .github/workflows/osv-scan.yml). A finding is suppressed ONLY by an entry here, so the gate can never be silently neutered. It covers both kinds of finding the gate fails on: a malicious-package advisory (`MAL-…`; suppress only a confirmed false positive) and a NEW HIGH/CRITICAL or unscored vulnerability. Each entry suppresses ONE advisory on ONE package at ONE version in ONE lockfile, never an advisory id everywhere. Each entry MUST carry: `id` (the advisory id or any alias: MAL-…, GHSA-…, CVE-…, GO-…), `package` (exact name), `version` (exact version), `lockfile` (exact repo-relative path of the lockfile the finding appears in), `justification` (at least 20 characters: why it is accepted, not exploitable in our usage, no fix available, upstream confirmed false positive), `added` (ISO date) and `expires` (ISO date, REQUIRED, at most 180 days after `added`). Past its expiry the entry stops suppressing and the risk must be re-justified. Wildcards, ranges and unknown keys are rejected. Bump the dependency FIRST; allowlist only when there is no fix. Mirrors security/npm-audit-allowlist.json.
